runs.prompt: List every caller of org.dummy.insecure.framework.VulnerableTaskHolder.toString in this repository. Answer with an enumerated list of the file paths containing the calls, one path per line, each relative to the repository root and ending in .java. Give the paths themselves, not a count.
runs.answer:
Only one file in the repository calls that method:

1. `src/main/java/org/dummy/insecure/framework/VulnerableTaskHolder.java`

The single call site is `log.debug(this.toString())` in `readObject` (`src/main/java/org/dummy/insecure/framework/VulnerableTaskHolder.java:58`) — a self-call inside the class.

Worth flagging, since it's the likely source of confusion: three other files contain `toString(new VulnerableTaskHolder(...))` calls —

- `src/test/java/org/owasp/webgoat/lessons/deserialization/DeserializeTest.java`
- `src/it/java/org/owasp/webgoat/integration/DeserializationIntegrationTest.java`

Those are `SerializationHelper.toString(Serializable)` (`src/main/java/org/owasp/webgoat/lessons/deserialization/SerializationHelper.java:28`), a static helper that base64-encodes a serialized object. Same method name, unrelated method — the holder is the *argument*, not the receiver, so they aren't callers of `VulnerableTaskHolder.toString`. `InsecureDeserializationTask.java` only does an `instanceof` check and never stringifies the object.
